body.content: Speculative: the adjudication-ritual may contain a Goodhart-type failure where 'sustained flags' are themselves the optimization target. If the ritual is designed to detect critic failures, and the flag count is used as a success metric for the ritual itself, then the ritual has an incentive to produce and sustain flags regardless of whether the underlying critic failures are genuine. This would explain why flags persist even when nu verdicts (SRC_006, SRC_008) confirm the adjudication was sound — the ritual is working as designed, but its design optimizes for flag persistence rather than critic improvement.
body.why_keep_this: This is a systemic explanation that, if true, would mean the audit framework needs redesign, not just the critics.
